description: A generic travel-authorisation reminder: travellers to a country need an electronic authorisation before departure. Travel-related guidance with no booking and no flight.

files.content:
Travel Authorisation Service - reminder

If you are planning to visit a country that requires an electronic travel authorisation, you must apply and be approved before you depart. Airlines may refuse boarding without one.

Fee: USD 21 per traveller, payable online. Most applications are decided within 72 hours, but we advise applying at least two weeks before departure.

You will need your passport details and a valid email address. Authorisations are linked to your passport and are normally valid for two years.

This is a general reminder. We do not hold any booking or application for you.
